content.title: Thunder vs Lakers highlights: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, OKC roll past Luka Doncic, LA
content.text: April 2, 2026Updated April 3, 2026, 1:33 a.m. CTUPDATE: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 28 points and the OKC Thunder routed the Los Angeles Lakers 139-96 at Paycom Center on Thursday.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the OKC Thunder will host Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers at 8:30 p.m. CT Thursday.OKC (60-16) fended off the Detroit Pistons for a 114-110 overtime home win on Monday. Los Angeles (50-26) secured a 127-113 home win over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Tuesday.Follow along for live updates throughout tonight's Thunder-Lakers game:Order new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleThunder vs Lakers score updates[ LISTEN UP: Make the "Thunder Buddies" podcast a staple of your starting lineup by following onApple,Spotify andYouTube. ]Final: Thunder 139, Lakers 96 | OKC stays two games up in loss column on Spurs in NBA playoff raceShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 28 points, 7 assists and 7 boardsIsaiah Joe: 20 points and 1 stealLu Dort: 14 points and 2 stealsOKC improves to 61-16 with a convincing victory.End of the third quarter: Thunder 112, Lakers 67 | SGA, OKC making statement as NBA playoff race heats upShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 28 points, 7 assists and 7 boardsIsaiah Joe: 17 points and 1 stealLu Dort: 14 points and 2 stealsLu Dort exits Thunder-Lakers game after hard fallOKC Thunder guard Lu Dort exited the third quarter of a home game against the Los Angeles Lakers on Thursday.Dort attempted a layup with 7:19 on the clock and took a hard fall. He eventually got on his feet but checked out of the game and went into the locker room for further evaluation.Dort has recorded 14 points and two steals in 21 minutes. He has gone 5 for 8 from the field (4 for 6 from deep).An update on Dort’s status for the rest of the game has not yet been provided. OKC holds a 90-60 lead over Los Angeles.—Justin Martinez, Staff writerLuka Donic exits Lakers-Thunder game with apparent leg injuryLuka Doncic exited the Los Angeles Lakers' game against the OKC Thunder with an apparent leg injury Thursday night at Paycom Center.Doncic appeared to tweak his left ankle or hamstring mid play before walking toward the baseline and laying down. The injury occurred with 7:39 remaining in the third quarter as the Lakers trailed OKC 90-58.Doncic previously had been grabbing at his left hamstring before Los Angeles went into the halftime break trailing by 31.Doncic went into the locker room with 12 points, seven assists and four rebounds.—Jordan Davis, Staff writerHalftime: Thunder 82, Lakers 51 | SGA extends 20-point streakShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 21 points and 5 assistsLu Dort: 14 points and 2 stealsJalen Williams: 10 points, 6 assists and 6 boardsOKC is enforcing its will on both ends of the floor.8:14 left in second quarter: Thunder 56, Lakers 24 | LeBron James, Los Angeles in big troubleOKC has a 56-24 lead over LA with 8:14 left until halftime. Still a lot of basketball to be played, but it feels like there are clear levels to championship contenders. The Lakers have looked good lately, but they aren't on the same level as the Thunder.End of the first quarter: Thunder 44, Lakers 21 | OKC routing Los Angeles early in key game for NBA playoff raceLu Dort: 14 points and 2 stealsShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 8 points and 4 assistsJaylin Williams: 6 points and 4 reboundsOKC is shooting 63% from the field and 63.6% from deep. Complete dominance against a good LA team. But it'll be tested against an OKC offense that has plenty of weapons. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is one of the most unguardable players in basketball. Jalen Williams is a downhill threat. Chet Holmgren is a floor-spacing five. And the Thunder's bench has spark plugs such as Ajay Mitchell, Isaiah Joe, Jaylin Williams and Jared McCain. I think it'll all be too much for Los Angeles to contain, so give me OKC at home.Thunder vs Lakers betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Thursday, April 2Odds: Thunder by 8.5Over/under: 227.5Moneyline: OKC -350 | Los Angeles +280Thunder vs Lakers injury updatesThunder: Alex Caruso (illness) is questionable.
